title: Claude Code plugin manifest
description: The .claude-plugin/plugin.json of a Claude Code plugin as Claude Code 2.1.330 accepts it (Agent Plugins Extended 1.1.0, chapter 2, with userConfig of section 3.4 and channels of section 9.3). An unknown top-level field is ignored by Claude Code and accepted here; an unknown key inside a strict object (a userConfig option, a channels entry, an LSP configuration, a monitor) is refused. A malformed display field, engines or network is ignored at load, with a note or a validator warning, and accepted here; $defs/effective states the values that take effect.
$comment: Not expressed here, and checked by a validator instead: that a path exists and stays inside the plugin, the reserved-name rule of section 2.3 item 2, a userConfig default that is one of its options, options that repeat a value in another letter case, unique monitor names, and ${user_config.KEY} references to undeclared options.

engines.description: The Claude Code versions the plugin works on (section 2.4). A value that is not an object, or a claude-code value that is not a range, is ignored at load with a validator warning or error and a note; other keys are ignored (Judgment J2.10). The form that takes effect is $defs/effective/properties/engines.

network.description: The hosts the plugin reaches, informational only (section 2.4). A value that is not an object with a hosts list, a malformed host and an unknown key are ignored at load with a validator warning (Judgment J2.10). The form that takes effect is $defs/effective/properties/network.

metadata.description: The author's own data; never given meaning (section 2.4).

types.description: A .d.ts file declaring a mod's $.state values and $ nouns (section 10).

themes.description: Still loaded at the top level, with a validator warning; belongs under experimental.

monitors.description: Still loaded at the top level, with a validator warning; belongs under experimental.

displayField.description: A display field: a value of the wrong type is ignored at load, with the note "<field>" in plugin.json is malformed and ignored, and the plugin still loads; a validator reports it as an error (section 2.1 item 3, Judgment J2.6). The type that takes effect is in $defs/effective.

$schema.description: A JSON Schema URL for editors; ignored by the client (section 2.2).

repository.description: A string; an object such as npm's {type, url} is ignored (section 2.2).

claude-code.description: A node-semver range such as ">=2.1.0"; outside it the client does not install, update or load the plugin, except from a local folder (section 2.4).

items.description: A host as sandbox.network.allowedDomains takes it: no scheme or path, plain ASCII (section 2.4).

effective.description: The values that take effect of the fields Claude Code ignores when malformed (display fields, engines, network); every other field is checked by the root. A manifest the root accepts and this refuses loads without the refused field.

pluginName.description: Non-empty, with no whitespace, @, :, path separator, control or bidirectional-formatting character (section 2.3 item 1). Kebab-case is recommended, not required.

url.description: A string that parses as an absolute URL.

componentPath.description: A path relative to the plugin root: it starts with ./ and has no .. segment (section 2.5).

skillsPath.description: A skills directory; "." and "./" both name the plugin root (section 2.5 item 1).

agentPath.description: An agent .md file, not a directory (section 2.5 item 4).

commands.description: Command files or directories, or a map of command name to entry (sections 2.7 and 4.6.2).

commandEntry.description: Exactly one of source and content (section 4.6.2).

hooks.description: A hooks file (with the hooks wrapper), the event map itself, or an array of either (section 2.8).

mcpServers.description: MCP configuration files, bundles, bundle URLs, an inline map, or an array of them (section 2.9). An inline server that Claude Code would drop fails the manifest (section 8.1 item 5).

monitors.description: A .json file holding the monitors array, or the array itself (section 9.2.1).

evals.description: Not a component path: section 2.5 does not apply (section 2.2).

default.description: Not compared with type: Claude Code accepts a default of another type (Judgment J3.9).

options.description: The fixed values of a string field (section 3.4.2).

channel.description: A message channel bound to one of the plugin's MCP servers (section 9.3.1).
